paper_title: A Universal Bound on QCD Axions from Supernovae
suggested_experiment_name: SN1987A universal QCD axion bound (This work)
notes: Paper derives a model-independent SN1987A bound on the QCD axion mass/decay constant: fa > 1.1e8 GeV (ma < 5.3e-2 eV) at 68% C.L. The main exclusion plot (Fig 5) is in the 1/fa vs ma plane (QCD axion line), so AxionMass is appropriate. Single bound point given; data point encodes (ma in eV, fa in GeV).
